# Capability Operator

A Muse agent skill that keeps your capabilities intentional: route an ambiguous or multi-domain request to the right workspace skill (explicit user selections always win), build an inventory of your skills folder, audit for duplicate or overlapping skills with classified overlap states, and verify a new skill is actually discoverable. Inventory and audits are read-only — nothing is deleted or merged without your explicit authorization. No account, no API key, no network needed.
